learning_outcomes.text: Students can select a suitable manufacturing process for the production of plastic components by understanding the specific physical principles of plastics in processing and use, and thus define the requirements for machine technology for primary shaping, especially injection molding. They can assess the influences of the manufacturing process on the quality of components and develop strategies to ensure lasting quality in mass production.

syllabus_topics: Physical properties of plastics for processing
Heat transfer processes in plastics processing (stationary and non-stationary)
Flow processes of plastic melts (rheology) - simulation application
Injection molding - process and influences on quality, special processes
Machine technology - melt generation with screws
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination. The grade's relevance to the final grade is determined by the study and examination regulations (SPO).
bibliography: Jaroschek, Spritzgießen für Praktiker, Carl Hanser Verlag
